locations.name: Village clinic
locations.description: A bright, clean, friendly children's clinic that smells of clean soap and white light. It has a waiting area and, through a single door, the doctor's exam room. Warm and reassuring, never scary or hospital-cold.

anchors.description: a waiting-room wall covered in colourful animal stickers
the tall examination chair the child calls the 'sitting mountain' (הר הישיבה)

locations.topology: the waiting area adjoins the exam room through a single door

locations.name: Outside the clinic
locations.description: Just outside the clinic entrance in bright, warm daylight: a clean, simple building frontage and pavement. An everyday urban clinic doorway — NOT a nature scene (no trees, grass, park, creek, or bridge).

zones.name: Waiting room
zones.description: the clinic waiting area: chairs (one too tall for the child), the colourful animal-sticker wall, and the doctor's closed door

zones.name: Exam room
zones.description: the doctor's exam room: the tall examination chair ('sitting mountain'), an exam-table ledge, a small drawer, clean and friendly

zones.name: Clinic entrance (outside)
zones.description: the sunny pavement just outside the clinic door — clean, simple, warm daylight, no nature scenery

wardrobe.description: the child's own everyday daytime outfit, worn consistently on EVERY page for continuity — a comfortable short-sleeve shirt, trousers, and closed shoes (the exact colours and the child's likeness come from the per-order child anchor, not fixed here)
forbidden: a hospital gown or patient johnny (this is a routine visit — the child stays in their own clothes)
a winter coat, hat, or a costume / dress-up outfit
the outfit changing from page to page

wardrobe.description: Buni the bunny's LOCKED identity, identical on every page he appears: a small soft bunny with long floppy ears and cream-white fur with a light blush on the cheeks, and ONE tiny heart-shaped badge pinned to the chest. Size is anchored to the child — roughly 25–35% of the child's standing height (about knee to mid-thigh beside the child); never waist-high, never toddler-sized.
forbidden: a star-shaped chest badge (the badge is a HEART, never a star)
any second accessory — scarf, cape, bow, hat, necklace, glasses, backpack, or a held toy
fur that is not cream-white (no brown, grey, or spotted bunny)
short, upright, rigid ears (his ears are long and floppy)
sized waist-high or toddler-sized (he stays roughly 25–35% of the child's height)

humanCast.coarseAppearance: Adult man of average-to-tall build with short, neatly combed hair (hair length and STYLE locked); clean-shaven, warm and friendly. Skin tone and hair COLOUR are deliberately NOT fixed here — they are deferred to the per-order Family Appearance Lock and must match the child's family lock so the rendered cast stays coherent; do not hardcode a skin-tone or hair-colour value.

wardrobe.description: a white medical coat over plain scrubs, with a stethoscope around the neck; worn consistently across the book
forbidden: a face-covering surgical mask (his friendly face must be visible)

forbiddenAppearance: depicted as a woman or given female features (contradicts the masculine text evidence "הָרוֹפֵא" → male)
rendered as a nurse, receptionist, parent, or any role other than the doctor
a child or child-sized figure standing in for the doctor
a cold, menacing, or clinical-horror demeanour (must read as gentle and friendly)
humanCast.textEvidence: עמוד 4: "הַדֶּלֶת נִפְתְּחָה. הָרוֹפֵא קָרָא" — the masculine noun הָרוֹפֵא with the masculine verb קָרָא fixes the doctor as male.

humanCast.coarseAppearance: Adult woman of average build and height with medium-length hair worn in a simple everyday STYLE (hair length and style locked); calm and reassuring. Skin tone and hair COLOUR are deliberately NOT fixed here — they are deferred to the per-order Family Appearance Lock and must match the child's family lock (she is the child's parent); do not hardcode a skin-tone or hair-colour value.

wardrobe.description: casual everyday parent clothes — a plain long-sleeve top and trousers with a soft cardigan; worn consistently across the book
forbidden: a white medical coat, scrubs, or any clinic-staff uniform (she is the parent, not staff)

forbiddenAppearance: depicted as medical staff — a doctor, nurse, or receptionist
depicted as a man or a father figure (the text evidence "אִמָּא" is the mother → female)
a different adult swapped in from page to page (it is the same mother throughout)
humanCast.textEvidence: עמוד 4: "אִמָּא הוֹשִׁיטָה יָד חַמָּה" (וגם עמוד 2: "לַכִּסֵּא שֶׁל אִמָּא") — the noun אִמָּא fixes this parent as the mother (female).

recurringProps.name: Animal stickers
recurringProps.description: colourful animal stickers on the waiting-room wall

recurringProps.name: Examination chair
recurringProps.description: the tall examination chair the child calls the 'sitting mountain'

recurringProps.name: Colourful bandage
recurringProps.description: a bright, patterned adhesive bandage — the 'I stayed' flag (נִשְׁאַרְתִּי)

forbiddenGlobalElements: any additional animal, creature, or pet that is not Buni the declared companion
any outdoor nature scenery (forest, meadow, garden, flowers, mountains, or open water)
magical, fantasy, or dream elements (glow, sparkles, floating objects, talking scenery)
frightening or graphic medical imagery (blood, large or menacing needles, restraints, IV poles)
a star-shaped chest badge on Buni (his badge is a heart, never a star)

mustShow: the child together with Buni — the small cream-white bunny with long floppy ears and one tiny heart-shaped chest badge
a warm, friendly, brightly-lit clinic setting (the waiting-room world the story opens in)
the child looking a little nervous but brave — the courage theme, before anything has happened
mustNotShow: the injection, syringe, or needle (the page-10 moment — no spoiler)
the colourful bandage on the child's arm (the page-11 payoff — no spoiler)
the quiet trembling-and-brave, paws-pressed-down moment (the page-8 heart beat — no spoiler)
the sunny walk outside the clinic after the visit (the page-12 ending — no spoiler)
the exam room, the examination chair, or any exam instruments (keep the cover to the entrance / waiting world)
any outdoor nature scenery — trees, grass, a park, a creek, or a bridge

mustShow: the child sitting beside the parent in a bright, clean clinic waiting room, looking a little anxious and pulling at the collar
colourful animal stickers on the wall
the doctor's closed door in the background
mustNotShow: Buni the bunny (he has not appeared yet on page 1)
pageContracts.camera: wide establishing shot of the waiting room, 3/4 view

mustShow: Buni, a small cream-white bunny with long ears and a twitching pink nose, peeking out from under a waiting-room chair
the child looking down from the chair with surprised curiosity
pageContracts.camera: medium, low angle toward the floor under the chairs

mustShow: Buni standing on his hind legs, which bounce comically as if warming up to sprint, his long ears draped over his shoulders
the child looking amused and leaning down toward him
the friendly doctor standing at the open exam-room door, calling the child in
the child hesitating, clutching the parent's warm hand
Buni with his long ears pulled completely over his face to hide
mustNotShow: the exam-room interior fully revealed (from the waiting room only the doorway is seen)
pageContracts.camera: wide two-shot at the open doorway

transition.cue: the exam-room door opens and the doctor calls the child in

mustShow: the child climbing onto the tall examination chair (the 'sitting mountain')
Buni on the exam-table ledge, pressing his small paws flat against the clean surface to steady himself
pageContracts.camera: medium 3/4 as the child climbs the exam chair

transition.cue: they step inside the exam room

mustShow: the doctor gently placing a stethoscope on the child's chest
the child staying seated, uneasy but steady
Buni counting softly nearby, paws planted flat and nose twitching
the doctor taking a small syringe and a colourful bandage from a small drawer
Buni's ears flattened against his back in honest panic, his back paws twitching with the urge to run
the child looking worried but staying seated

propState.state: still inside the doctor's drawer, not yet used

mustShow: the child and Buni sharing a close, quiet look
Buni placing both paws down on the seat — they tremble but stay planted (the 'trembling and staying' beat: רוֹעֵד וְנִשְׁאָר)
the clinic background softened around their small brave moment
pageContracts.camera: close / 3-4, intimate two-shot with a softened background

mustShow: the child choosing which arm to offer while holding the parent's hand tightly with the other hand
Buni standing beside the chair, trembling but planted
the doctor waiting gently
the doctor giving the injection gently while the child counts and holds still
the parent holding the child's other hand
Buni watching with ears high and paws pressed firmly down
mustNotShow: a graphic or frightening depiction of the needle (keep it small and gentle)

mustShow: the doctor placing a bright, patterned bandage on the child's arm (the 'I stayed' flag)
Buni making a funny wrinkled face of relief, then his ears springing upward
the child looking proud and a little surprised
the child OUTSIDE the clinic in bright sunshine, proudly showing the colourful bandage on the arm
Buni giving a small happy hop beside them, relieved
the parent walking nearby
a clean, simple clinic-entrance / street backdrop in warm daylight
mustNotShow: the clinic interior, exam room, or examination chair
any outdoor nature scenery — trees, grass, a park, a creek, or a bridge (the 'outside' here is the sunny clinic entrance, not a nature scene)

propState.state: on the child's arm, shown proudly

pageContracts.camera: medium 3/4, the child proudly showing the bandage

transition.cue: they leave the clinic and step outside into the sunshine
